intro: Doan Karhan is a human scholar and practitioner of the dark arts dwelling isolated in the southern Barrens. He has dedicated his life to researching the demonic artifacts of the Burning Legion, especially the enigmatic Orb of Soran'ruk.

p: Tucked away in a solitary camp in the wild savannah of the southern Barrens, Doan Karhan lives far from the civilized bastions of the Alliance. Rather than seeking ordinary solitude, he retreated to the wilderness to study dangerous demonic relics unmolested. Doan holds deep lore concerning powerful fel vessels, possessing the Orb of Zargain and obsessing over the legendary Orb of Soran'ruk. Practicing warlocks often seek him out when delving into artifact crafting and dark rituals.
